# US Wholesale Supplier Directory Scraper (Wholesale Central)

Build a clean list of **US wholesale, dropship and closeout suppliers** from [WholesaleCentral.com](https://www.wholesalecentral.com). Search by keyword, browse any of the 54 live supplier categories, crawl several categories in one run, or refresh a known list of supplier URLs. Get public company contact data, location, minimum-order terms, social links and an optional product-catalog summary — with no login. Wholesale prices are not published by the source and are not claimed here.

## What this actor does

- **Three discovery modes:** keyword search on the supplier tab, live-category browsing (one or up to 10 categories), and direct supplier-URL refresh
- **Supplier-first search:** uses the site's supplier tab (`tab=suppliers`), so results are companies rather than the default product cards
- **Contact detail:** phone, full address, website, company description and social profiles from each supplier page
- **Location precision:** city, state name, two-letter state code, postal code and country, plus exact state filtering (`NY` / `New York` no longer matches Albany, Oregon)
- **Product-catalog summary:** product count, per-category counts, collection count, up to 8 sample products (name, SKU, link) and ships-from country — no extra request
- **Optional embedded contacts:** business email addresses and extra phone/fax numbers that the page payload contains but the site does not visibly publish; off by default
- **Reliable crawling:** handles the site's AWS WAF browser challenge, paginates 30-card category pages and 40-card search pages, deduplicates by supplier URL, and stops at `maxItems` or source exhaustion
- **Empty fields are omitted** — no null, blank or sentinel noise in the output

## Output per supplier

Identity and listing fields:

- `recordType`: always `"supplier"`
- `name`, `slug`
- `detailUrl`, `sourceUrl`: the supplier's public WholesaleCentral page
- `category`: readable label of the category page the supplier was found on
- `supplierType`: legacy label echoed only for old saved inputs that still send `supplierType`; omitted for new inputs
- `location`, `city`, `state`, `stateCode`, `postalCode`, `country`
- `memberSince`: year the supplier joined the directory
- `minimumOrderUSD`: minimum order in USD (`0` means the listing says “No minimum order”)
- `isFeaturedListing`: `true` when the listing carries a Featured badge
- `websiteUrl`: the supplier's own website
- `phone`, `address`, `companyDescription`
- `socialMediaLinks`: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X/Twitter, Pinterest, YouTube or LinkedIn links
- `categories`: the supplier's main directory categories
- `scrapedAt`: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp

Added from the supplier page (when `includeDetails` is on):

- `productCount`, `collectionsCount`
- `categoryCounts`: array of `{name, count}` product categories
- `sampleProducts`: up to 8 objects with `name`, `sku` (when shown) and `url`
- `shipsFrom`: the shipping-origin country shown on the page

Added only when `includeEmbeddedContact` is explicitly enabled:

- `email`, `emails[]`, `salesEmail`
- `fax`, `additionalPhones[]`

These contact values come from the supplier profile payload embedded in the public page — they are business contacts, not displayed contact buttons. Review your privacy, consent and outreach obligations before enabling this option. Website footer or directory-operator addresses are filtered out.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `byCategory` | `byCategory` (browse), `search` (keyword), or `bySupplier` (specific URLs) |
| `category` | string | `Apparel` | One of the 54 live top-level categories (mode=byCategory) |
| `categories` | array | – | Crawl up to 10 live categories in one run; overrides `category` |
| `customCategorySlug` | string | – | Advanced: a narrower category slug, e.g. `Mens-Apparel`; overrides `category` |
| `searchQuery` | string | – | Keyword for supplier search (mode=search); required in that mode |
| `supplierUrls` | array | – | Full URLs, paths, or slugs to refresh (mode=bySupplier) |
| `state` | string | – | Exact US state filter; accepts `NY` or `New York` |
| `maxMinimumOrderUSD` | int | – | Keep suppliers whose minimum order is at most this amount; undisclosed minimums pass |
| `keyword` | string | – | Keep suppliers whose name or description contains this text |
| `featuredOnly` | bool | `false` | Keep only Featured (premium/paid) listings |
| `includeDetails` | bool | `true` | Read each supplier page for contact and product-summary fields |
| `includeProductSummary` | bool | `true` | Include product count, category counts, sample products and ships-from |
| `includeEmbeddedContact` | bool | `false` | Opt in to page-embedded business email and extra phone/fax numbers |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | off | Optional Apify proxy; the actor connects directly first and picks a working connection automatically if the site blocks it |
| `maxItems` | int | `20` | Hard cap on records (1–500); each category is additionally capped at 100 cards |

### Example: apparel suppliers with full contacts and product catalogs

```json
{
  "mode": "byCategory",
  "category": "Apparel",
  "includeDetails": true,
  "includeProductSummary": true,
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: supplier search for candles

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "candles",
  "includeDetails": true,
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Example: multi-category crawl filtered to New York

```json
{
  "mode": "byCategory",
  "categories": ["Apparel", "Fashion-Accessories", "Jewelry"],
  "state": "NY",
  "includeDetails": true,
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: refresh a known supplier list

```json
{
  "mode": "bySupplier",
  "supplierUrls": [
    "https://www.wholesalecentral.com/suppliers/fourse0001",
    "https://www.wholesalecentral.com/suppliers/sheandsky"
  ],
  "includeDetails": true,
  "includeEmbeddedContact": false
}
```

## Use cases

- **US sourcing shortlists** — find domestic wholesale suppliers by category and state without browsing the directory by hand
- **Dropship and closeout research** — map the Dropshippers and Closeout Suppliers departments, then compare minimum orders
- **B2B lead lists** — collect public company phone, address and website data for retail-buyer outreach
- **Catalog discovery** — see how many products a supplier carries and which product categories dominate its storefront
- **Geographic market mapping** — compare supplier density across states and categories
- **Refresh existing vendor lists** — re-scrape a saved set of supplier URLs to pick up changed contacts or catalogs

## FAQ

**Does this need a login or a proxy?** No login. Every supplier page used here is public. The actor connects directly first, solves the site's browser challenge, reuses that session, and automatically picks a working Apify connection if the site blocks it. You do not need to configure a proxy.

**Why are there no wholesale prices?** The directory shows “Unlock wholesale price” to signed-in buyers. Public pages — and this actor — do not expose wholesale prices, tiers or MOQs beyond the published minimum-order amount.

**Why does search return a different number of suppliers than a category?** The site's supplier search returns roughly 51–136 matches for common queries, while top-level categories contain 2–90 suppliers each. `maxItems` still caps what is emitted.

**Why did `state: "NY"` previously return an Oregon supplier?** The old filter searched for `ny` inside city names and matched “ALbany”. This version normalizes US state names and two-letter codes and compares the state/state-code fields exactly; the city is never searched.

**What is `minimumOrderUSD: 0`?** It means the listing explicitly says “No minimum order” — a real value. If the minimum order is not disclosed, the field is omitted.

**What does `productCount: 0` mean?** The supplier has no products in its public storefront. `productCount` is omitted when the page does not show a count at all.

**Why is `includeEmbeddedContact` off by default?** The site embeds supplier business email addresses and extra phone/fax numbers in the page payload but does not display them in the contact panel. Because that is a privacy-sensitive difference, the actor emits them only when you explicitly opt in and warns you to use them lawfully.

**Why do some records lack a phone, website, description or social links?** Not every supplier publishes every field. Empty values are omitted rather than written as null or a placeholder.

**Can I get the whole directory in one run?** The public category/search crawl reaches about 368 unique suppliers across the 54 live categories. `maxItems` can be set up to 500. A single category is capped at 100 cards per run (the largest live category has 90), and a run can crawl up to 10 categories.

**Is this affiliated with WholesaleCentral.com?** No. This is an independent tool that reads the directory's public supplier pages; it is not run or endorsed by WholesaleCentral.com.

## Limitations

- Wholesale prices, buyer-only MOQ tiers and order terms are login-gated and are not included.
- The site does not expose a per-supplier “verified” badge, so no verification field is invented; Featured placement is the only premium-listing signal.
- The directory's marketing figure (“1,400+ suppliers”) is larger than what the public category and search pages expose; a full audit in October 2026 reached 368 unique supplier pages across 54 live categories.
- The site uses an AWS WAF browser challenge, so the first request of a run can take a few seconds longer while the session is established.
